trap.label: verbo vs substantivo
trap.wrong: The expand of cities causes pollution.
trap.right: The expansion of cities causes pollution.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa a base do verbo como substantivo. Em inglês, é preciso o sufixo: expand → expansion.

fix.wrong: The failed of the project was clear.
fix.right: The failure of the project was clear.

rewrite.prompt: Nominalize: “Because they planned weakly, the project failed.” (Poor …)
rewrite.answer: Weak planning led to the failure of the project.

rewrite.prompt: Nominalize: “Cities expanded, and pollution rose.” (The … of cities)
rewrite.answer: The expansion of cities raised pollution.

rewrite.prompt: Verbalize: “The failure of the project was a surprise.” (The project … a surprise → failed)
rewrite.answer: The project failed, which was a surprise.
